note: The exotic-fruit stalls among potted palms, a seller behind each stall. Feminine nouns to the left of the green iron pillar (x=640), masculine to the right. The arch on the left goes back to the fruit stalls; the opening on the right, past the coconut palm, leads to the vegetable stalls.
